1. The vote

Every player always has a voice. This voice determines wheter the story in the OP is deemed fitting for the story we are trying to build.

If you feel a player has written a good story and you like the post leave an

[](#aye)

If you feel the player's story would disrupt the game or take it in an unwanted direction, leave a

[](#nay)

When you leave a Nay on someone's post or comment you will need to also explain why you chose to vote Nay.

The ratio of Aye and Nay will determine the probability for the post to pass. Players should always remember to vote. A potentially powerful action could pass without a vote. The more players who vote, the more realistic the game is.

1.1 Frequently Asked Questions

 If I vote "Nay" on blessings and curses against my own creations is that metagaming?

This depends on your motivation. It is perfectly legal to vote Nay on curses against your own creations. The Nay has to come from a feeling that the curse is overpowered or that the curse takes the game in an unwanted direction. Saying Nay to spite the other person or saying Nay to further your own interests is Metagaming.

 Can gods (or any character, for that matter) have discussions via PM about alliances or other actions?

Any character can corroborate with any other character, however, meta gaming is not allowed. Only the subverse is canon, if you have made a deal over pm or over irc with another player you still need to have a post on the subverse to give you plausible deniability for making this allegiance. If you have no established (Accepted as canon by the community) storyline as to how your allegiance came to be it's metagaming.
I would add that players should always vote. A potentially powerful action could pass without a vote. The more players who vote, the more realistic the game is.

4. The players

4.1 God

A God has 3 domains. In each of these domains they get +1 Savagery.

Gods can:

  • Create Artefacts
  • Create Demigods
  • Create Races & Fauna
  • Create Realms
  • Curse & Bless, Aid & Sabotage anything in the game.

Gods are not allowed to directly smite Demigods, Heroes, Races.

  • If the Savagery of a God falls to Zero, the god has been banished to the void and needs to wait 2 Sabbats to return. They then return with 10 Savagery. In the meantime the player can claim another character.

4.2 Demigods

A Demigod has 1 domain of limited scope. In this domain they get +1 Savagery.

A Demigod starts with the Savagery it was created with, this Creation Value will reflect it's strength.

Demigods can:

  • Perform actions in their limited domain
  • Attack Gods, Demigods, Heroes, Races
  • Curse/Bless/Aid/Sabotage non god actions
  • Receive Special Rules

Demigods cannot create Artefacts, Realms or Demigods.

  • If the Savagery of a Demigod falls to Zero it is destroyed forever.

Uncontrolled Demigods act like any other permanent.

4.3 Heroes

A hero starts with 30 Savagery

A Hero perfroms Heroics, as such they get +1 savagery on everything they do.

Heroes also have plot armor, reducing damage taken by 1.

Heroes can:

  • Discover & Use Artefacts
  • Heroes can ascend to become Demigods & retain Hero traits
  • Heroes can learn Magic, Combat, Artefact Control, Technology
  • Attack Demigods & Heroes
  • Lead a war effort of a race
  • Aid or Sabotage a race or hero
  • Receive Special Rules

Heroes cannot do God or Demigod things.

  • If the Savagery of a Hero falls to Zero, the Hero dies. He can be resurrected by a god infusing him with new Savagery.

4.4 Races

A race player can have multiple heroes, these heroes cannot ascend.

A Race starts with 30 Savagery. The Savagery they were created with will reflect the strength of their first stronghold.

Races can:

  • Expand their strongholds
  • Expand their economy
  • Develop technology
  • Train armies
  • Attack Races, Heroes & Demigods
  • Aid or Sabotage a race or hero
  • Receive Special Rules

Races cannot do God or Demigod things.

  • If a Race loses all strongholds the race becomes extinct.

6. How does it all work?

6.1 A topic

Everything starts with a nicely written story about your endeavors in our universe. You may make the post as prozaic as you want.

At the end of your post we want you to write out in plain language what the intended effects are, how much SV you spend to make it happen and what your remaining total is.

The extents of what you can do are determined by the other players on the subverse. The other players will read your story and decide if they think this is a good addition to the universe. If your post get's too many Nay's it is likely to fail and the game will continue as if your story never happened.

If the post is accepted the Arbiters will make up a summary, that summary will become cannon.

If the post fails, none of it happened, no one lost or gained anything.

Secrets

A secret action has a 5% chance of being discovered. Discovered secrets open up interaction to all other players.

Otherwise the action is flaired as Secret. What happens in secret actions cannot be use by the other players to metagame against you. Other players cannot interfere with your secret action.

If you wish you can share a secret action with other players, the players part of a secret may interact.

7 The decision making

7.1 General decision making.

This applies to all posts, curses, blessings,...

Once 24 Hours has past the arbiters will count up all visible , and then they will count the total for the action.

Then our Chaosbot, programmed by @failure, will decide the end result in IRC by using the command

!sv aye nay sv

The Aye/Nay turn into a probability for the post to pass. Chaosbot will tell if the post was a Succes or not.

Then he will return a Savagery outcome for the action. The outcome is picked at random from a scaled Gauss graph with mu = sv and sigma = sv/4

7.2 Conflict posts

For damaging actions

POWERSCALING APPLIES, BE CAREFULL!

In a conflict post players need to say what they use and what they target. In the comments, each player says what they use and who they target. Each player can only attack one thing in a conflict post.

Players can also Aid, Sabotage, Bless or Curse the players involved in a conflict. These will be applied before resolution.

The attacks will then be executed chronologically to post date, when the target strikes back, the attack resolves simultaneously.

The targets will lose their respective damage received in Savagery.

Autodefend - The player targetted in the original thread automatically strikes back at his agressor if the player is AFK.
